text: [Management of inferior polar comminuted fractures of patella and patellar tendon injury]. . OBJECTIVE: To investigate the treatment and effectiveness of inferior polar comminuted fractures of patella and patellar tendon injury. METHODS: Between January 2003 and December 2008, 5 patients with inferior polar comminuted fractures of patella and patellar tendon injury were treated with Nitinol Patellar Concentrator and fascia lata allograft. There were 3 males and 2 females with a mean age of 33.7 years (range, 20-48 years). The interval of injury and operation was 1-5 days. Fracture degree: 3 cases had 3 fractures of patella, 2 cases had 4 fractures; patellar tendon injury degree: 3 cases had horizontal rupture of middle ligament, 1 case had oblique rupture of tibial tubercle, and 1 case had longitudinal partial rupture. RESULTS: Healing of incision by first intention was achieved in all patients, and no complication of infection or deep venous thrombosis occurred. The X-ray films at 2 days after surgery showed that patella recovered to normal height, which meaned ratio of patella height to patellar tendon length recovered to 1 : 1. Five cases were followed up 18 months on average (range, 10-22 months). At 3-12 weeks after surgery, the knee function of the injury side almost reached that of the normal side in 4 patients, and the knee range of motion was about 100 degrees in 1 patient. The fracture healing time was 3-5 months. At 12-15 months after surgery, patella holder was taken out and no lost of reduction or refracture occurred. During follow-up, there was no fracture displacement, loosening and breakage of implant, or rerupture of patellar tendon. According to ZHANG Chuncai's criterion for knee joint function, the results were excellent in 3 cases, good in 1 cases, and fair in 1 case with an excellent and good rate of 80%. According to XU Shaoting's criterion for knee joint function, the results were excellent in 2 cases, good in 2 cases, and fair in 1 case with an excellent and good rate of 80%. CONCLUSION: Nitinol Patellar Concentrator and fascia lata allograft is a new method to treat inferior polar comminuted fractures of patella and patellar tendon injury, and it can ensure the knee joint stability in early motion after surgery.
title: [Management of inferior polar comminuted fractures of patella and patellar tendon injury].

text: The Turkey and Turkey Products . The mative of turkey is North America.It a food with features of high protein,low fat and low cholesterol.Turkey industry has been rising in China in recent years.This article summarized the biological characteristics,nutritional value,turkey products,market and consumption of turkey.The development prospect is also be summarized.
title: The Turkey and Turkey Products

text: Value Realization and Social Approval of Journal Evaluation . After having realized the two original functions of optimizing library collection and helping the readers effectively retrieve information,journal evaluation was widely accepted and favored by the academic field.Hence,its social function was realized.Derivation functions were thereafter produced,such as providing reference for documentation database's selection of source journals,for science management department evaluating academic achievements,helpful for reasonable competition among journals and their academic improvement.However,journal evaluation faced unprecedented censure and criticism and enjoyed the lowest social approval when it was used as the only standard to evaluate academic achievements and work efficiency.Journal evaluation should go back to its original functions and the study on it must be further carried out.
title: Value Realization and Social Approval of Journal Evaluation

text: Zhou Xuexi and Modernization of Northern China in Modern Times . Zhou Xuexi was an outstanding representative of national enterprises in modern China. An analysis and study of the characteristics of his enterprise, the influence of his enterprise upon implement of government economy, historical position of his enterprise in modernization of economy in northern China will provide a rewarding appraisal of his function and influence on modernization of northern China in modern times.
title: Zhou Xuexi and Modernization of Northern China in Modern Times

text: A study on the extraction method DNA from the aged bone . The STR multiplex method is not efficient in amplifying DNA samples from the aged bones due to the degradation of the DNA extracted and the presence of PCR inhibitors in the collagens of the aged bones.For the purpose of solving this problem,the CTAB method has been established to extract DNA from bones previously soaked into the water,burned and buried for approximately 10 years.The CTAB method was effective in removing the PCR inhibitors from the aged bones and then the DNA were success- fully genotyped by using the fluorescence labeling STR multiplexing method.
title: A study on the extraction method DNA from the aged bone

text: Design and Implementation of Embedded Network Video Server Based on SOC Architecture . This paper introduces the design of embedded network video server based on SOC architecture, and its implementation in terms of hardware structure and software frame,which uses GM8120 as the mastership chip,integrating the encoding and decoding of MPEG4 in addition to 32 bit CPU of FA526 RISC. Therefore,there's no need to design the audio and video module,thus simplifying the system.Software platform adopts the Linux operating system,which is transportable,cuttable and real-time multi-tasking,to deal with complex network transfer protocol,which ensures the stability and reliability.
title: Design and Implementation of Embedded Network Video Server Based on SOC Architecture

text: STUDY OF SIMULATION ON RADIANCE FROM INFRARED AND WATER VAPOR CHANNEL OF FY2B BY A FAST FORWARD MODEL-RTTOV7 . In order to simulate the radiance of infrared and water vapor channels of FY2B with RTTOV, a multi-variables linear regression was used to produce transmittances by using spectral response functions of these channels and a precise transmittances database of 600-3000 cm(-1) generated from GENLN2 at 6 viewing angles. When the same atmospheric profile and the new coefficients were put into RTTOV, simulation of FY2B and GMS showed that similar channel radiances were obtained. The comparative analysis of the deviation between the simulated radiances obtained with the profiles from ECMWF model forecast and the new coefficients for FY2B in RTTOV and the real observation for infrared and water vapor channels of FY2B indicate that the satisfying precise of radiances can be obtained within very short time.
title: STUDY OF SIMULATION ON RADIANCE FROM INFRARED AND WATER VAPOR CHANNEL OF FY2B BY A FAST FORWARD MODEL-RTTOV7

text: Using Analytic Hierarchy Process Establish Key Subjects Evaluation Model . On the basis of key subjects in hunan province declaration and acceptance index system,identify evaluation system of key subjects,determine the weight of index system with analytic hierarchy process,establish evaluation model appling in practical work.through the analysis of the importance of evaluation index system,giving some proposals to strengthening key subjects of the construction and management.
title: Using Analytic Hierarchy Process Establish Key Subjects Evaluation Model

text: OCCURRENCE OF NIOBIUM AND TANTALUM IN THE Nb-Ta DEPOSIT IN WEATHERED GRANITE CRUST AT SHANGBAO, LEIYANG , HUNAN PROVINCE . There are three types of niobium and tantalum deposits in weathered granite crust at Shangbao, Hunan Province,i.e.,tantalite-columbite ore(Type I), Nb-rutile ore(Type II) and microlite tantalite-columbite ore(Type III). These oreminerals contain 46.36% of niobium and 50.94% of tantalum in Type-I ores,43.37% of niobium and 56.44% of tantalum in Type-II ores, and 48.81% of niobium and 66.37% of tantalum in Type-III ores. Zinnwaldite is another important Nb-Ta-bearing mineral, it contains 5.71% to 17.2% of niobium and 2.33% to 12.52% of tantalum .
title: OCCURRENCE OF NIOBIUM AND TANTALUM IN THE Nb-Ta DEPOSIT IN WEATHERED GRANITE CRUST AT SHANGBAO, LEIYANG , HUNAN PROVINCE

text: Problems and Strategies on Developing City Civil Natural Gas Industry . To solve problems occurred in development of city civil natural gas industry such as government planning lag,unbalanced market regulation structure and dispersed operational area of the enterprise,we should make up a long-term plan for promoting natural gas utilization and development,set up a kind of dynamic balance between governmental regulations and market structure and build an interest coordination mechanism between the enterprises.City civil natural gas industry therefore can keep development in a standardized and scientific way though optimizing management and operation modes.
title: Problems and Strategies on Developing City Civil Natural Gas Industry

text: Status Changes of Shaanxi & Shanxi Merchants in the Ming and Qing Dynasties . In the Ming Dynasty,the Shaanxi and Shanxi merchants rose at the same time and maintained the top of China's ten major commercial groups for a long time.In the Qing Dynasty,the Shanxi and Huizhou merchants held the first,while the Shaanxi merchants followed them in the third or even later reduced to a more inferior role.The change of status of Shaanxi and Shanxi merchants represents the rise-and-down of their strength.Based on the development course of the two great commercial groups in Shaanxi and Shanxi provinces,the results of analysis show that the change of their status results from four aspects.The first is that the Shanxi merchants' management model of partnership is superior to Shaanxi merchants' family business mode.Second,the Shanxi merchants' do better job in selecting and cultivating business talents than Shaanxi merchants',as the Shaanxi merchants prefer Confucianism to business but the Shanxi merchants devote to business,and different social customs causes the gap in business talents.Third,Shaanxi merchants are not as good as Shanxi merchants at keeping proper relation with government officials or taking advantages to protect and expand their business.Fourth,the merchants in two provinces suffered different degree of damage of war.
title: Status Changes of Shaanxi & Shanxi Merchants in the Ming and Qing Dynasties

text: Studies on the absorption kinetics of famotidine in rats' intestines . To explore the absorption mechanism of famotidine from various intestinal segments, the absorption kinetics and permeability rate constants(ka) were investigated by the in situ perfusing method in rats. It was showed that the small intestine was the best absorption segment. The permeability rate constants were 0 050 8 , 0 044 6 , 0 041 5 , 0 028 7 h -1 respectively at duodenum, jejunum, ileum and colon. The absorption mechanism of famotidine was studied at different concentrations. No saturation phenomenon occurred and at the same time, ka was kept unchanged. The results indicated that the absorption of famotidine compiled with the passive transport mechanism and first order kinetics.
title: Studies on the absorption kinetics of famotidine in rats' intestines

text: Effects of Structure and Molecular Weight of Poly(lactide-co-glycolide) on in vitro Release of Naltrexone Microspheres . Poly(lactide-co-glycolide)(PLGA)with different molecular weights, monomer molar ratios, with or with-out optical activity and modification of chain terminal were prepared and the physicochemical properties were determined. Invitro release of naltrexone microspheres prepared with the various PLGA were compared. The results showed that the releasevelocity of microsphers prepared by PLGA with the lower molecular weight, optically active, lower lactide-glycolide molarratio and acetylated modification was faster.
title: Effects of Structure and Molecular Weight of Poly(lactide-co-glycolide) on in vitro Release of Naltrexone Microspheres

text: A Research on Synthesis of Acetylsalicylic Acid Catalyzed over Aminosulfonic Acid under Ultrasound Irradiation . Acetylsalicylic acid is synthesized under ultrasound irradiation,using salicylic acid and acetic acid anhydride as raw materials and catalyzed over aminosulfonic acid. The optimum reaction conditions are selected,molar ratio of salicylic acid to acetic acid anhydride is 1:2:0.003,and the irradiation power is 250W,the irradiation time is 15min.The yield was over 95.8%.
title: A Research on Synthesis of Acetylsalicylic Acid Catalyzed over Aminosulfonic Acid under Ultrasound Irradiation

text: Application Research of Audio Feature Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm . Based on the research of audio feature,this paper extracted the features of loudness and pitch,and selected their feature weights by PSO.We proposed an automatic evaluation method of singing segment which was already applied to video song-on-demand marking system.According to the results of the experiments carried out,the systems characterizes similar degree of the singer singing and singing original sound in real time so that the marking standards are efficient.
title: Application Research of Audio Feature Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm

text: Effects of water and fertilizer supply on nitrate content in tomato fruit . 【Objective】 The effects of irrigation amounts and fertilizer rates of nitrogen,phosphorus and potassium on nitrate content in tomato were investigated to improve the production of high quality tomato.【Method】 Jinpeng 1 was used as experimental material.Using a pot experiment and quadratic orthogonal regressive rotation design with four factors,a regression model of water and fertilizer mounts and nitrate content in tomato was established.Single and coupling effects of all four experimental factors were studied.【Result】 If other factors were zero codes,nitrate content increased at first and then eventually reduced as the increase of irrigation amount and or K fertilize rate while the nitrate contents constantly increased as the increase of P and N fertilizer rate.The interactions between irrigation amounts and K fertilizer rates and between N and P fertilizer rates were positive,while the interactions were negative between irrigation amounts and P fertilizer rates and between N and K fertilizer rates.【Conclusion】 It was indicated that nitrate content in low irrigation amount decreased when reducing P or with reasonable K fertilizer rate.It was effective to increase nitrate content in tomato by adding P or with reasonable K when N fertilizer rate was reduced.
title: Effects of water and fertilizer supply on nitrate content in tomato fruit

text: Relationship between electrochemical performance and microstructures for spherical Ni(OH)_2 . Scanning electronic microscopy(SEM) and X-ray diffraction(XRD) were used to research microstructures of spherical β-Ni(OH)2 and the relationship between its electrochemical activity and the microstructures was discussed. It was found that the layer-like and spindle-like exterior morphologies point better and larger crystalline,and better electrochemical performance than grain-like ones for the spheres of β-Ni(OH)2 though they share the similar interior microstructures as fine radiate crystal faces. There are trivial positive relativity between discharge capacity and interfacial distance of (001) FWHM 001, as well as the full width at half maximum of (101) diffraction peak FWHM101.There is obvious negative relativity between the discharge capacity and FWHM001, that shows that the discharge capacity is positively related to the size of crystallines in 001direction and agrees on the influence of the exterior morphologies to discharge capacity for Ni(OH)2.
title: Relationship between electrochemical performance and microstructures for spherical Ni(OH)_2

text: PBL Instruction Based on Inversed-pendulum in Principles of Automatic Control . In this paper,we introduce PBL to instruction in the curriculum of Automatic Control Principles.Based on our inversed-pendulum experimental platform,we designed PBL schemes and discussed the principle of designing and performing the PBL instruction.Practical teaching effects showed that PBL teaching can combine the fundamental theory with engineering practices,enhance student go-aheadism of solving practical problems,and achieve the cultivation goal of team cooperation and innovation abilities.
title: PBL Instruction Based on Inversed-pendulum in Principles of Automatic Control

text: EVALUATION ON ECOLOGICAL SERVICE VALUE OF SOIL AND WATER CONSERVATION MEASURES IN DANJIANGKOU RESERVOIR AREA . Ecological service value of soil and water conservation measures planed to execute in Danjiangkou reservoir area was quantitatively estimated by applying basic principles and methodology of environmental economics.Results show that the total ecological service value brought by short-term soil loss control project was evaluated about 3.274 billion Yuan per year.The total value was composed by different types of ecological service value,including water resource conservation value 0.448 billion Yuan,prevention and cure of water pollution value 0.791 billion Yuan,soils losses prevention value 1.027 billion Yuan,carbon sequestration oxygen release value 0.314 billion Yuan,air purification value 0.352 billion Yuan,biodiversity conservation value 0.341 billion Yuan.Hence,the value of soils losses prevention,water pollution prevention and cure was the most important ecological service value from soil and water conservation measures in study area.Moreover,the annual cost of the water conservation measures was about 0.239 billion Yuan on the basis of opportunity analysis,indicating that the anticipated eco-economic benefit of the project was obvious,and the ecosystem service value was 13.69 times as much as the cost.The result in this paper could provide some reference for quantitative ecological value analysis of long-term ecological construction project.Also,it could be used as theoretical foundation to carry on ecological compensation system in water source region.
title: EVALUATION ON ECOLOGICAL SERVICE VALUE OF SOIL AND WATER CONSERVATION MEASURES IN DANJIANGKOU RESERVOIR AREA

text: Eco-hydrological Processes and Its Salinization Effects in Saline Soil Regions . The ecological processes,hydrological processes and the coupling effects in different spatial and temporal scalings are the main causes of some eco-environmental problems,especially the soil salinization in the saline soil regions.The study on the effects of eco-hydrological processes on soil salinization includes the following topics:soil water and solute transport,the pattern of the surface water and its ecological effect,the ecological groundwater level and eco-environmental water requirement.However,one has also to reveal the eco-hydrological mechanism of the saline soil formation and evolution.The future topics on the eco-hydrological processes effect on the saline soil region should include:ecological process,hydrological process and the coupling effect between them;the transfer between the surface water,groundwater and soil water,with ecological effect;the eco-environmental water requirement based on the eco-hydrological process;the eco-hydrological model in the catchment.
title: Eco-hydrological Processes and Its Salinization Effects in Saline Soil Regions

text: Study on Heat Shock Rrotein . The heat shock proteins(HSPs)are an evolutionarily conserved family of proteins synthesized by organism in response to adverse stress,nowadays the study of HSPs has been one of heat and hopeful fields in world-wide biology.This article talks about the types of HSPs,its biological characteristics and functions,the research significance of HSPs is discussed as well.
title: Study on Heat Shock Rrotein

text: Prediction Problem of the Next Failure Time for the Weibull Distribution . Prediction problem of the failure time of life test from the Weibull Distribution are discussed in detail in this paper,the mothod of the parametric and the nonparametric estimation is used,these results have directory sense to life testing of the products which life follows the weibull distribution.
title: Prediction Problem of the Next Failure Time for the Weibull Distribution

text: Prediction of drug plasma concentrations in human by a physiologically based pharmacokinetic model for Paracetamol in rats . Objective: To estimate Paracetamol plasma concentration in human by establishing a flow limited physiologically-based pharmacokinetic(PBPK) model in rats.Methods: According to blood perfusion limitation characteristics,we established a platform based on acslXtreme modeling and analysis system to simulate physiological-based pharmacokinetic flow using PBPK model.Data on physiological parameters were collected in rats and human.Validity of the model was assessed by comparing the findings from current study and previous studies.Then,the human physiological parameters were put into the model to predict dynamic precess of Paracetamol plasma concentration.Results: A PBPK model representing five organs/tissues for Paracetamol was developed.The predicted values by the model were comparable to the findings in published literatures.Conclusion: The model could predict the drug concentration-time process of Paracetamol in rats accurately.However to apply to human,the structure and parameters of the model need further modification and optimization.
title: Prediction of drug plasma concentrations in human by a physiologically based pharmacokinetic model for Paracetamol in rats

text: SURFACE FEAT URES OF QUARTZ GRAINS IN GOUGES FROM YISHU FAULT ZONE AND THEIR SIGNIFICANCE .
title: SURFACE FEAT URES OF QUARTZ GRAINS IN GOUGES FROM YISHU FAULT ZONE AND THEIR SIGNIFICANCE

text: Theory calculation and experiment verification of silicon carbide particle grading optimization . Three most optimal match has been calculated by grain composition optimized model in the system of packing particle,the most optimized bulk density and packing density have been acquired by the experiment of three grain size silicon carbide particles,and the calculation results of the theory model have been compared.The result shows: the most optimization of different particle grading and packing density is according with the theory model,and the particle bulk density and packing density are maximum when the particle grading is 70∶10∶20.
title: Theory calculation and experiment verification of silicon carbide particle grading optimization

text: Research on Structure,Properties and Preparing Techniques of LiNi_(1/3)Co_(1/3)Mn_(1/3)O_2 as Cathode Material . Layered mixed cobalt/nickel/manganese oxides as positive electrode materials for Li-ion batteries are of great interest due to their desirable properties.The development of layered lithium mixed cobalt/nickel/manganese oxides cathode materials for rechargeable lithium batteries is reviewed.The inter-relationship between the structure and the electrochemical properties and thermal stability of LiNi_(1/3) Co_(1/3) Mn_(1/3) O_2 is introduced in detaiL The effects of preparation methods on the performance of this material are reviewed.The improvement of the material induced by different elements doped such as Mg,Al,Ti,Cr,F is mentioned.The development of cathode material LiNi_(1/3)Co_(1/3)Mn_(1/3)O_2 for lithium-ion batteries is prospected.
title: Research on Structure,Properties and Preparing Techniques of LiNi_(1/3)Co_(1/3)Mn_(1/3)O_2 as Cathode Material

text: Design and simulation of ground source heat pump system used in archives . Because of the importance of protecting the collections stored in archives the building environment of archives should be kept at constant temperature and humidity year-round which will consume a lot of energy.The use of ground source heat pump with the ground as the source of the cooling and heating is the efficient means to save energy.It can meet the requirement of being an energy-saving type archive.In view of the unbalance of load in summer and winter in Shanghai,heat recovery technology has been applied to solve the problem.The result of simulation analysis shows that it should reasonably increase the depth of the location of buried pipes if possible,and the heat recovery technology can alleviate the heat accumulated in ground without influencing the operating performance of the heat pump.
title: Design and simulation of ground source heat pump system used in archives

text: Analysis Model of Medical Consumptive Materials based on Independent Component Analysis . Goal:Excavates and the control medical consumes the material demand the influence factor,causes the medical consumption material the management to hasten the scientific style and the standardization.Method:Uses independent component analysis principle processing medical to consume the material demand quantity data,established medically has consumed the material demand quantity data processing the mathematical model.Finally:Medically unifies some kind to consume the material,has produced the processing example and performs to inspect the analysis.Conclusion:Medical consumes the material demand analysis model based on the independent component has the count for much significance regarding the instruction medical consumption material management and the control.
title: Analysis Model of Medical Consumptive Materials based on Independent Component Analysis

text: NUMERICAL MODELING OF VSP MULTICOMPONENT RECORDS IN CRACKS ANISOTROPIC MEDIUM . From considering common cracks anisotropic medium in anisotropic media, 1D3-component equation is calculated. The equation is similar in zero-section VSP survey. In order to conform to readily, the paper leads into coordinate rotation so that wave field of multi-layers anisotropic media about arbitrarily azimuth in well can be modeled. Using finite element method, numerical modeling are achieved.Obtaining R3×3 matrix section is emphasized specially, and so R3×3 matrix section is ordinarily analyzed and explained. The several special wave phenomena are stressed.In fact, rich anisotropic information is contained in R3×3 matrix section.
title: NUMERICAL MODELING OF VSP MULTICOMPONENT RECORDS IN CRACKS ANISOTROPIC MEDIUM

text: Rerecognization on Placebo by Using the Standards of Evidence-based Medicine . The therapeutic power of placebo is well recognized. Placebo has been argued since it is used in medical domain. Today,evidence-based medicine was widely accepted,and how to estimate placebo is a problem we have to confront.
title: Rerecognization on Placebo by Using the Standards of Evidence-based Medicine

text: A Model of the Risk Investment with the Original Assets . This paper sets up a mathematical programming model for the combinnation of risk investment with the original assets, maximizing the return under the up bound of the total risk. Using the property of optimality of the model, we can obtain a simpler and more general model.
title: A Model of the Risk Investment with the Original Assets

text: Hydraulic optimal design for flood discharge structures in Three-Gorges Project . It is required that the flood discharge capacity of the Three-Gorges Dam should reach(100?000?m~3/s) and(70?000?m~3/s) in the operation period and construction period,respectively.The pattern of interlaced arrangement of 23 permanent deep flood discharge holes,22 surface holes and 22 temporary base diversion holes shortens the length of overflowing,and overcomes the difficulties in flood discharge of the project.With the characteristics of large number,large dimension,high water head,large variation range of water level,and long period and high frequency of operation,deep holes are the main flood discharge structure,especially for floods with intervals less than 1?000?years.Meanwhile,they undertake the third stage water diversion and flood control to ensure the safety of cofferdam during power generation in flood seasons.By experimental study of 4 different schemes for deep hole arrangement,the layout scheme of short pressurized conduit connected with open discharge channel was selected in the Three-Gorges Project(TGP),with the quarter ellipse curves adopted at upstream dam surface of weir crest and intake side of surface holes,and downstream weir surface connected with a slope of 1∶0.7 and further an ogee spillway for R=30?m.By experimental study and analysis of the short pressurized conduit and long pressurized conduit layout schemes for base diversion holes,the scheme of long pressurized conduits is finally adopted.
title: Hydraulic optimal design for flood discharge structures in Three-Gorges Project

text: Development of Series Floor Waterproof Wax . The prescrption composition of series flour waterproof wax is determined through study the complex formulation of raw oil,raw wax and additives,the laboratory analysis and customer use effect shows,this series wax has well chemical stability and thermal stability and waterproof property,can replacment European imported similar product completely.
title: Development of Series Floor Waterproof Wax

text: Study of carbonate equilibrium based on activity . In this article, the relationship between the three existing forms of carbonate and pH value is studied at different temperatures and CO_2 pressures in an open underground water system while activity is taken into consideration.We find that the value of pH_0 decreases with the increase of temperature and tends to a stable value at a given CO_2 pressure and the value of pH_0 decreases with the increase of the CO_2 pressure at a given temperature when CO_2 pressure changes in the range of 10～10~5Pa and the temperature changes in the range of 0～30℃. However, no matter how the temperature and CO_2 pressure of the underground water change, pH_0=7.92～8.60. These conclusions reflects the actual conditions of the underground water and can be better used for the review of water analysis data.
title: Study of carbonate equilibrium based on activity

text: Crisis management and countermeasures in nursing in hospital . Modern hospitals are confronted with various crisis at any moment.Nursing crisis characterized by unexpectedness,uncertainty and urgency.In crisis management of nursing,it is necessary to deal with crisis designedly,organically and systematically.Based on the principles of preventive control,timely and initiatively,practical and realistic,patient first and active communication,it is necessary to develop emergency system and management plans,strengthen nurses’ crisis consciousness,improve nurse-patient communication to turn the crisis into opportunity.
title: Crisis management and countermeasures in nursing in hospital

text: Design and Realization of DAQ-card for 100MHz-Virtual-Oscilloscope . A new solution is introduced to design of digital-storage oscilloscope based on Virtual Instrument.With PCI interface,the sample frequency is up to 100MHz when the DMA mode is devoted to data transmission.Parameters for sampling are user-defined.The sampling result may be displayed in software panel or saved in PC HD.The instrument is now used successfully.
title: Design and Realization of DAQ-card for 100MHz-Virtual-Oscilloscope

text: A Rational Interpretation of "the Sloping Grade Line in College Entrance Examinations"——Comment on Li Lifeng's new book A Study on Regional Equity in China's College Entrance Examinations . Dr.Li Lifeng has carried out in his new book A Study on Regional Equity in China's College Entrance Examinations a research,which has been so far the most comprehensive and the most thorough-going, into the complicated focal point of theSlopping Grade Line in the College Entrance Examinations.The book is based on the compound justice theory and accompanied by a theoretic framework with adequate explanatory power,thus transcending all the earlier achievements in this field of studies and marked by a diachronic approach in the research,which guarantees the research level and also holds an original discussion on a series of issues including the principle of justice for higher education admission opportunities,the root cause and proper handling of the sloping grade line in the college entrance examinations as well as the orientations of reform.
title: A Rational Interpretation of "the Sloping Grade Line in College Entrance Examinations"——Comment on Li Lifeng's new book A Study on Regional Equity in China's College Entrance Examinations

text: Hydrothermal-electrochemical technology and it's applications for preparing of ceramic thin films . In this paper, hydrothermal electrochemical technology, which is one of the important soft solution processings (SSP), was introduced, the basic concepts and characteristics of the technology were discussed, the applications and advantages of the technology for preparing advanced ceramic thin films were outlined, and the prospects of the technology for use in advanced inorganic materials were forecasted.
title: Hydrothermal-electrochemical technology and it's applications for preparing of ceramic thin films

text: Study on the Photoreaction Between Alkyl Amine and Selenium Dispersion in Heptane .
title: Study on the Photoreaction Between Alkyl Amine and Selenium Dispersion in Heptane

text: Experience and exploration on the implementation of humanity education for student nurses at our college . Toenhance the humanityeducation for our student nurses,in recent years,our col-lege has done innovation on humanity courses by increasing its proportion,enhancing the penetration of humanity education into other courses. We have strengthened the cultivation of humanity emotion bypaying attention to the development of recessive courses and constructing the fantastic humanity environment by the means of practical activities.
title: Experience and exploration on the implementation of humanity education for student nurses at our college

text: The Significance of Restricting Salt Intake in Prevention and Cure of Hypertension . Cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases have become the No.1 “killer”of human being.The risks of suffering cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases correlate positively with blood pressure levels.Persons with hypertension are much more possibly hit by cardiovascular and cerebrovascular accidents than those with normal blood pressure. The causes of hypertension are remarkably complex, which may be the results of interaction between several factors.Excessive salt intake may be an important factor causing the high incidence of hypertension in modern society. This paper attempted to uncover the root cause of high salt intake-induced hypertension from the point of view of human evolution, and further to illustrate the significance of restricting salt intake in prevention and cure of hypertension.
title: The Significance of Restricting Salt Intake in Prevention and Cure of Hypertension

text: A MODELING OF THE EFFECTS OF GROUND SURFACE WEATHERING LAYERS ON REFLECTED SHEAR WAVES IN SEISMIC EXPLORATION . The propagation of seismic shear waves in an indicative weathering model is modelled. It is found that the weathering layers change the waveform and amplify the main amplitude by a factor of 2.5. The effects of the weathering layers on the waveforms, which is supposed to be uniform without the weathering layers, result in a significant horizontal variation in the seismic section. This variation would be mistakenly interpreted as the change of reflectors, which would in turn mislead further exploration and (developments). Therefore, it is of importance to develop techniques to calibrate the effects. Before an (effective) technique is applicable, it is desirable to avoid selecting sites with bad weathering for seismic (acquisition). Or otherwise, the possibility of reflected waveforms being distorted by weathering layers should be kept in mind to avoid making faulty interpretation.
title: A MODELING OF THE EFFECTS OF GROUND SURFACE WEATHERING LAYERS ON REFLECTED SHEAR WAVES IN SEISMIC EXPLORATION

text: Design and implementation of the intelligent temperature controller based on 128×64 dot matrix liquid crystal display . Based on the intelligent temperature controller design experiment, a design scheme of the liquid crystal display module (LCM) driving experiment is given in this paper. The functional properties, the interface circuit, and the application program of the LM3033 LCM are introduced in detail. In this experiment, the temperature signal is collected through the DS18B20 digital temperature sensor, and then transmitted to the MCU. The temperature signal processing and the intelligent control are performed by MCU. At the same time, informations, such as ambient temperature and system status are displayed on the LM3033 LCM.
title: Design and implementation of the intelligent temperature controller based on 128×64 dot matrix liquid crystal display

text: Numerical analysis of the the changes of porous media during soil vapor extraction . Numerical method was developed to study the change of porous media caused by physical air perturbation during soil vapor extraction(SVE).This method incorporates a water-air two phase flow model to estimate dynamics of the saturation,the relative permeability and capillary pressure during SVE,and varations of porosity is interacted based on its relationship with the saturation in the two phase flow model.Then an application of this method is shown for a field SVE case.The results reveal that the influence radius of a single SVE well were up to 8.5m and 9m at the extraction pressure of 0.9-105 Pa and 0.7-105 Pa respectively.That indicates influence radius is proportional to the extraction vacuum for a specified site.Both the porosity and permeability increased abruptly after SVE beginning and a steady state was then gradually achieved,whilst the increases induced in vadose zone weakens with distance and the time need to reach a peak delayed with increasing distance from the SVE screen.In this case,at P1 and P4 reached the maximum of 0.0387 in 40 min and 0.0031 in 60 min respectively,whilst the permeability at P1 and P4 increased from 1.18-10-11 m2 to 2.22×10-11 m2 and 1.25×10-11 m2 correspondingly in such simulation scenario with the extraction pressure of 0.7E5Pa and parameter =0.8.In addition,changes of porosity and permeability were suggested to be proportional to value and extraction vacuum.The maximum were up to 0.009(at =0.1) and 0.055(at =0.8) under the same extraction pressure of 0.9-105 Pa,while it was up to 0.066 under the scenario with the extraction pressure of 0.7-105 Pa and =0.8.
title: Numerical analysis of the the changes of porous media during soil vapor extraction

text: The Analyses of Female Spaces under Influence of Traditional Culture of China . Chinese traditional culture affect the traditional creation,so as Construction art.Under the special culture background of China the relationship of gender show the moral order and hierarchy,it also translates to the space and behavior.Aiming to the situation,this paper is about the research of female living spaces in the traditional Chinese vernacular architecture.The ultimate goal of this research is to discuss that the new generation of architects should take a special look at women’s gender differences,and design real comfortable architecture for people.
title: The Analyses of Female Spaces under Influence of Traditional Culture of China

text: BCKLUND TRANSFORMATION OF THE SOLUTIONS OF DIFFERENT EQUATIONS .
title: BCKLUND TRANSFORMATION OF THE SOLUTIONS OF DIFFERENT EQUATIONS

text: On Metafiction and Metafictionality . The author attempts to conduct a theoretical investigation into in this essay,one of the key words in contemporary Western literary criticism.It is held by the author that a comprehensive view of metafiction as a critical terminology should embrace both its stability and relativity.The author distinguishes metafiction from metafictionality on the basis of this stance and maintains that while the former falls into a literary genre,the latter is a concept of textual function.It is also argued that a mobile picture on the development of fiction should be the combined product of both perspectives.
title: On Metafiction and Metafictionality

text: The discovery of some super-large size gold deposits from the relation between subject and object . The discovery of some large, super-large size gold deposits at home and abroad and its developmental law are discussed from the relation between subject and object. The discorery, extension and exploration of the gold depesits with distinct guiding significance are sumed up and revealed in this paper.
title: The discovery of some super-large size gold deposits from the relation between subject and object

text: FAIRNESS OF BONUS-MALUS SYSTEM IN FINITE TIME . Every insurance company has its own bonus-malus system. The main purpose is to make sure fairness while paying the premium, that is to say, the premium paid by the insured is proportional to his risk. Since the car is the object of insurance, and the lifetime of the car is short, the fairness of the Huatai’ BMS is discussed based on the premium per unit risk from the viewpoint of finite time. Furthermore, the finite time efficiency of the BMS is studied by numerical methods.
title: FAIRNESS OF BONUS-MALUS SYSTEM IN FINITE TIME

text: A comparison between domestic and overseas post-graduate training modes . Post-graduate training program as a main approach of training high-level professional personnel has provided a large number of talents for various walks of life in China.On the basis of analyzing overseas advanced experience,this paper discusses the measures for improving China's post-graduate training mode.
title: A comparison between domestic and overseas post-graduate training modes

text: Channel Roughness Calibration Model Based on Multi-parent Genetic Algorithm and Its Application . In order to improve the calibration precision of channel roughness,one-dimensional channel unsteady flow model is built to calibrate roughness by using multi-parent genetic algorithm.The roughness calibration model is verified by measured main channel section data of middle route of South-to-North water diversion project.The result shows that the method has good fitting effect of water level,which can be applied to channel roughness calibration.
title: Channel Roughness Calibration Model Based on Multi-parent Genetic Algorithm and Its Application

text: Analysis of Power Frequency Flashover Test on Over Voltage ProtectionDevice of Three Phase Combined Type . The main characteristics of the over-voltage protection device of three phase combined type(TBP)are intruduced;The spark-over characteristics of TBP at power frequency are analyzed based on the on-site testing practic and the testing data.The problems existing in the testing method of spark-over voltage at power frequency,TBP design and other aspects are also discussed.Advice on improving the design and testing method of the production is given.
title: Analysis of Power Frequency Flashover Test on Over Voltage ProtectionDevice of Three Phase Combined Type

text: Analysis of Monitoring Technology of Deep Excavation Engineering . Essential measures are proposed to monitor deep excavation engineering,based on the monitoring contents and methods,the application of measuring and testing equipment,and the general monitoring program of the established excavation enclosure structure.Through the practical monitoring to an 18-storey residential building,analysis is made on the horizontal displacement of enclosure structure,the stress levels and the building and plot's settlement around.
title: Analysis of Monitoring Technology of Deep Excavation Engineering

text: Effect of Exogenous Putrescine (Put) on Postharvest Physiology and Its Related Enzyme Activity of Nectarine [Prunus persica (L.) Batsch var.nectarina Maxim.] . In this paper,the effect of exogenous putrescine (Put) on chilling injury rate,chilling injury index, flesh firmness,total soluble solids (TSS),titratable acidity (TA),respiration,ethylene production,and activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD),peroxidase (POD),catalase (CAT) and lipoxygenase (LOX) of the nectarine (Prunus persica var.nectarina) variety‘Qinguang 2’were studied.The results showed that the chilling injury of nectarine fruits stored at 0℃was delayed for 10 d by exogenous Put treatment,the chilling injury rate and chilling injury index were different from control.Put significantly raised the activities of membrane SOD,CAT and POD and inhibited the LOX activity,meantime,the Put decreased the ethylene production and the respira- tion rate,delayed the respiration peak and the ethylene peak,slowed down the decrease in the flesh firmness, and made the content of TSS at a high level.However,it showed no remarkable effect on the contents of TA.
title: Effect of Exogenous Putrescine (Put) on Postharvest Physiology and Its Related Enzyme Activity of Nectarine [Prunus persica (L.) Batsch var.nectarina Maxim.]

text: Study on legal system of electronic bills . Started from the tendency of e-bills market and enactment and enforcement of electronic signatures law,the conflict between e-bills and the theory of commerce instrument law in force was analyzed from four aspects such as written form,original document,signature and effect of evidence.Based on the research about our country's electronic signatures law,the realistic significance of affirming the legal status of e-signatures was elaborated.Which reviews that extensive interpretation to commerce instrument law and building registration system of e-bills can solve its perfecting problem.
title: Study on legal system of electronic bills

text: Decomposition of Impact Factors of Industrial Dust Emission in China . Dust emission is one of primary issues of industrial pollution in China.To study major driving force and solution of industrial dust emissions,industrial output and environment emission of year 2001-2009 were collected to describe basic condition of industrial dust emissions.Method of Logarithmic Mean Divisia Index(LMDI)was used to decompose impact factors of industrial dust emission into 4 parts,including scale effect,structure effect,technology effect and governance effect,and the impact and developing trend of each factor were compared.Results showed that scale effect is still a major driving force for industrial dust emission and structure effect will be the key solution to reduce industrial dust emission in future.6 sub-industries were identified,among which chemical engineering and metal industries were taken as key sub-industry based on dust production and emission of each sub-industry.It is pointed out that governance effect is critical for chemical engineering and metal industries to reduce dust emissions.
title: Decomposition of Impact Factors of Industrial Dust Emission in China

text: Effects of ZSM-5 zeolite catalysts modification conditions by liquid Si deposition on toluene disproportionation reaction . ZSM-5 zeolite was modified by chemical liquid Si deposition.Some catalysts with different Si deposition content were prepared,and their reaction properties were evaluated on fixed bed minitype reactor.The effects of SiO_2 deposition content,modification times and properties of non-zeolite on the modification were investigated.By means of infrared ray spectrum(IR) and BET specific surface test,the catalysts and the modified catalysts were characterized respectively.The results show that with the addition of SiO_2 deposition,conversion of toluene decreases,the selectivity increases,and side reaction increases.Acid non-zeolite is not suitable for secondary component of toluene disproportionation catalyst.
title: Effects of ZSM-5 zeolite catalysts modification conditions by liquid Si deposition on toluene disproportionation reaction

text: The Withered Cell and Cardiovascular Diseases . Objective:Eualuating relations between withered cell and cardiovascular diseases. Method:Looking for the documents and synthesizing an argument.Result: The process of withered cell relates many knids of cardiovasculas diseases. Conclude: The Withered cell supplies the new thinking for revealing attacking mechanism of cardiovascular diseases and secking for prevention and control of biology.
title: The Withered Cell and Cardiovascular Diseases

text: Seedling Breeding Technology of Big Hazelnut with Cold Resistance .
title: Seedling Breeding Technology of Big Hazelnut with Cold Resistance

text: Discussion on Mountain Tunnel Waterproof Design and Construction . Tunnel waterproofing is the common issue in tunnel engineering.Despite increasing progress of tunnel waterproof design and increasing improvement in waterproof construction,water leakage still exists in many tunnels after completion,which increases tunnel maintenance cost.This paper discusses the defects of mountain tunnel waterproof design and possible problems in waterproof construction and puts forward a series of measures such as adding vertical and horizontal blind pipes in foundation,setting mechanical protecting plate for side wall,carrying out sectional waterproof construction,strengthening qualification management to increase and improve mountain tunnel waterproof engineering quality.
title: Discussion on Mountain Tunnel Waterproof Design and Construction

text: Erection technique of king-sized metal spiral case . With the continuously enhancement of the national power of China,the hydropower industry is also being developed vigorously.A great number of large-sized hydropower projects have been completed or under construction or proposed to be built.In combination with the installation and welding procedures of turbine spiral cases for huge hydropower stations,such as Wuqiangxi,Ertan and Three Gorges,etc.,this paper describes the erection technique of king-sized metal spiral cases and presents proposals for discussion.
title: Erection technique of king-sized metal spiral case

text: Preparation and Characterization of Comb-like ZnO Nanorod Array . The comb-like ZnO nanorod array with 2-fold symmetrical have been successfully synthesized by hydrothermal method on zinc aluminum carbonate nanosheets. The hierarchical ZnO nanorods were characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD), field emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM). The possible growth mechanism of hierarchical ZnO nanostructures is proposed.
title: Preparation and Characterization of Comb-like ZnO Nanorod Array

text: A Survey on Health Risk Behaviors of Undergraduates in Chongqing . To investigate the present situation of health risk behaviors,an anonymous questionnaire surveying on health risk behaviors was conducted among 1228 undergraduates from five universities in Chongqing.Results as follows:Health risk behaviors were common among the undergraduates.The prevalence of no seatbelt use was 60.6%.The prevalence of usual cigarette smoking and usual alcohol use was 14.7 % and 55.1 %.The prevalence of the net surfing and being addicted in net was 91.8% and 7.4%.The prevalence of feeling depressed was 45.1% and seriously considering of suicide attempt was 5.1%.6.2% reported that they had the experience of sexual intercourse.The scores were significant difference in gender,grade,urban and rural areas,single child and living on campus.The male students who have poor academic performance,higher level of his father's literacy and living off campus were more likely to develop health risk behaviors.There was a significant positive correlation between any two kinds of health risk behaviors of unintentional injury behavior,violence behavior,smoking,suicide,insecure sexual behavior and internet addiction disorder behavior.
title: A Survey on Health Risk Behaviors of Undergraduates in Chongqing

text: The Way of Suggestion and the War of Investigative Psychology . Investigative process is that of a psychological war, to which some psychological tactics must be applied. The way of suggestion is a very important psychological tactics. It is manifested in a numerous forms, among which the most frequently applied are language, article and scene suggestion.
title: The Way of Suggestion and the War of Investigative Psychology

text:
KEY PHYSICAL PROBLEMS IN DEEP DIELECTRIC CHARGING ON SATELLITES . Deep dielectric charging (DDC) is one of the key factors inducing malfunctions and failures on geo-synchronous satellites. In this paper, the mam problems such as charging time, electric field distribution, as well as influences on DDC-induced maximum field by shield, dielectric thickness and grounding patterns are studied in detail, and some results of computer simulation are introduced for the plannar model. In the meantime, some preliminary measures for DDC protection are re-commended accordingly.
The charging time depends on both dielectric parameters and flux of high ener-getic electrons in the space environment. For epoxy, a kind of usually used dielectric material on satellites, the charging time is in the order of hours. The electric field distribution in the dielectric is determined by the grounding pattern. For the case grounded on single side, the maximum field generally appears on the grounded side with the other side having zero field. While for the case grounded on both sides, both sides have maximum fields, with values smaller than single-grounded case. Moreover, the maximum field in the dielectric is related to the thickness of the dielectric itself and the applied shield. The maximum field increases with the dielectric thickness to a saturated value, and decreases with the shield thickness, however, contribution of the shield over a certain thickness is neglegible.
title: KEY PHYSICAL PROBLEMS IN DEEP DIELECTRIC CHARGING ON SATELLITES

text: On Tang's Poems Gathering Together and Disseminated by the Palace Music's Organization in Tang Dynasty . The palace music organization in Tang Dynasty mainly has Taichangsi,Liyuan and Jiaofang.They can collect and disseminate Tang's poems besides their service for Tang Dynasty palace by music.So these palace music organizations have an important function for gathering together and disseminating Tang's poem in Tang Dynasty.It is very helpful for spreading the fame of the poet,encouraging the poet to create more poems to match music.And it laid a foundation of music for spreading the poem to the future generations.
title: On Tang's Poems Gathering Together and Disseminated by the Palace Music's Organization in Tang Dynasty

text: Applying Possibility Degree Method for Ranking Interval Numbers to Partnership Selection . A new interval number ranking approach is applied for assessment of priorities of the alternative partners,where the attribute values are given out as interval numbers while the weight of each criterion is still exact numerical value pattern.After aggregating with the weighted arithmetic averaging operator,the result is still in the form of interval number.To achieve the priorities of alternative partners we take the possibility method for ranking interval numbers into account which could derive priorities from inconsistent attribute values,thus eliminating the adjustment to the inconsistent attribute values.Moreover,this method is very simple and needs less calculation.An illustrative example is given out to demonstrate this smart method.
title: Applying Possibility Degree Method for Ranking Interval Numbers to Partnership Selection

text: Study on the formation of circular patterns of α-Fe_2O_3 nanoparticles via chemical vapor deposition with water and ferrocene . Circular patterns of α-Fe_2O_3 nanoparticles were formed by chemical vapor deposition from a mixture of water and ferrocene on silica surface at temperatures above 950℃.The features of the patterns,e.g.,the average size and size distribution,the average separation distance and the size of the α-Fe_2O_3 nanoparticles forming the patterns,were found to be dependent on deposition conditions such as the deposition temperature and the ratio of water/ferrocene,etc.By adjusting these deposition conditions,large-scale circular patterns of α-Fe_2O_3 nanoparticles were successfully created on the silica substrate.These patterns might serve as submicron templates for growing low-dimensional materials such as carbon nanotubes.The features of the patterns and the Fe_2O_3 particles could profoundly affect the topologies and performances of the nanostructures which are nested on them.
title: Study on the formation of circular patterns of α-Fe_2O_3 nanoparticles via chemical vapor deposition with water and ferrocene

text: Study of Submarine Laser Communication . Submarine laser communication possesses many potential advantages over traditional communication methods.Submarine laser communication system can be divided into two kinds,which are satellite laser communication and airborne laser communication.The satellite laser communication is a global system which is suitable for communications with strategic missile nuclear submarine,and the airborne laser communication is much more fit for communications with tactical submarine.In this paper,these two systems are introduced.
title: Study of Submarine Laser Communication

text: Study on Composition and Preparation Procedure and Quality Control of Vaginal Sustained-Release Progesterone Gel . OBJECTIVE To study the composition,preparation procedure and quality control of sustained-release progesterone gel.METHODS Using dynamic viscosity and in vitro release as index,the composition and preparation procedure of progesterone gel were optimized,and the method of quality control was studied by HPLC and TLC.RESULTS The conditions to determine in vitro release of gel were established.The composition and preparation procedure of gel were optimized.There were no differences of release between sample and control sample.The method of quality control was achieved.CONCLUSION Preparation procedure is convenience and reliable.The HPLC and TLC assay are sensitive,accurate and no-interference.
title: Study on Composition and Preparation Procedure and Quality Control of Vaginal Sustained-Release Progesterone Gel

text: Glycosylphosphatidylinositol-anchored protein(GPI-AP)deficiency on blood cells of patients with aplastic anemia and paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria . Objective To investigate the deficiency of glycosylphosphatidylinositol-anchored pro-teins(GPI-AP) in patients with aplastic anemia (AA) and paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria(PNH). Methods Flow cytometry (FCM), REDQUANT CD55/CD59 and CELLQUANT CD55/C59 kits were used to assess the expression of CD55 and CD59 on peripheral erythrocytes and granulocytes of 47 AA patients and 42 PNH or AA-PNH patients. Results A variant degree of deficiency of GPI-AP expression was found on granulocytes and/or erythrocytes in 16/47 (34.04 % ) AA patients, and the positivity of deficient cells was significantly lower than PNH and AA-PNH( P 0.01) . Conclusion Varying degrees of GPI-AP frequently existed in AA, PNH and AA-PNH.The ratio of deficient cells was implicated in the differentiation of the related diseases and disease transformation.
title: Glycosylphosphatidylinositol-anchored protein(GPI-AP)deficiency on blood cells of patients with aplastic anemia and paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria

text: The constrain of abyssal faults system to abiogenetic gas in Songliao basin . Described gas reservoir distribution and the relationship with the deep faults in Songliao basin by analyzing the abyssal faults distribution within the basin,basic characteristics of the basin evolution,structural development of the control action,as well as abiogenetic gas formation,pattern,and concluded abiogenic formation and distribution of natural gas is controlled by the deep faults in the Songliao basin.
title: The constrain of abyssal faults system to abiogenetic gas in Songliao basin

text: Indirect child mortality estimation technique to identify trends of under-five mortality in Ethiopia . BACKGROUND: In sub-Saharan African countries, the chance of a child dying before the age of five years is high. The problem is similar in Ethiopia, but it shows a decrease over years. METHODS: The 2000; 2005 and 2011 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey results were used for this work. The purpose of the study is to detect the pattern of under-five child mortality overtime. Indirect child mortality estimation technique is adapted to examine the under-five child mortality trend in Ethiopia. RESULTS: From the result, it was possible to see the trend of under-five child mortality in Ethiopia. The under-five child mortality shows a decline in Ethiopia. CONCLUSION: From the study, it can be seen that there is a positive correlation between mother and child survival which is almost certain in any population. Therefore, this study shows the trend of under-five mortality in Ethiopia and decline over time.
title: Indirect child mortality estimation technique to identify trends of under-five mortality in Ethiopia

text: Research on Photosynthetic Characters of Castanea mollissima BL . A study was made of the diurnal of the photosynthetic characters in different breeds of Chinese chestnut and of the relationship between them.The results of measuring and analyzing the photosynthetic characters show that there is a difference and also a similar law in their daily change,and that for different breeds,the gas-degree and rate of photosynthesis bear a significant relevance to the transpiration rate factors.
title: Research on Photosynthetic Characters of Castanea mollissima BL

text: Learning Mandarin Chinese as a Foreign Language: Evidence-Based Strategies for Teaching Students with Disabilities . Learning Mandarin Chinese as a Foreign Language:Evidence-based Strategies for Teaching Students with DisabilitiesGET AHEAD! LEARN MANDARIN! was the headline appear ing on the cover of TIME magazine (Ramzy, 2006) reporting that, because of China's remarkable economic boom-from the classrooms in the United States of America (USA) to the boardrooms of Tokyo, Japan-the world has been awakening to the importance of learning Mandarin, the national language of the People's Republic of China. Fluent Mandarin Chinese has become a must-have asset for many students' future and professionals hoping to benefit from China's booming economy. In Britain, a poll of business executives rated Mandarin Chinese as the third most useful language for their employees to learn after French and German. The Schools Secretary proposed all secondary schools should offer classes in Mandarin and provide opportunities to learn Mandarin Chinese to primary school students (Shepherd, 2010). In the USA, not only do many universities offer Mandarin Chinese courses as a foreign language, many local school districts have also launched English-Chinese dual-language immersion programs for their secondary and primary school students (Bonacci, 2013; Dillon, 2010; Robelen, 2011; Rubello, 2013; Ruethling, 2005; Tran, 2008). The increased interest in Mandarin Chinese in the USA is evident by a 51 percent increase from 2002 in the number of students studying Mandarin in colleges and universities across the country (Robelen, 2011). Although thousands of public schools across the USA have stopped teaching foreign languages since 2000, many schools have expedited offering instruction in Mandarin Chinese due to student demand (e.g., Bonacci, 2013; Robelen, 2011). For example, according to Robelen (2011), between 2004-2005 and 2007-2008 enrollment in Mandarin Chinese classes increased 195 percent. In the USA, Mandarin Chinese instruction is no longer limited to port entry cities such as New York, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. In recent years, schools throughout the USA have started Mandarin Chinese programs in mid-western states (e.g., Ohio, Illinois), southern states (e.g., Texas, Georgia), and Mountain West states (e.g., Colorado, Utah). In many cases, Mandarin is available for students from preschool through high school.Inclusive EducationIn the USA, the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA; 2004) and its predecessor, IDEA (1997), supports previous legislation regarding the inclusion of children with disabilities in general education classrooms. An inclusive classroom is an instructional setting where students with disabilities are included in a general education classroom and where both a general education teacher and a special education teacher provide instruction. IDEA 1997 and 2004 mandate that an individualized education plan (IEP) must be developed for each student with disabilities which includes provisions to ensure that the student be meaningfully involved and given the opportunity to make progress in the general education curriculum. Because of federal legislation, many children with special needs are able to study together with their typical peers in the same instructional settings. Like their typical peers, students with disabilities should have the same rights and opportunities to learn a foreign language. Participation in inclusive programs have a beneficial impact on students with and without special needs, resulting in positive gains such as increased and more meaningful social interactions (Purcell, Horn, & Palmer, 2007). For example, in inclusive classrooms, young children with special needs demonstrate higher levels of social play and show gains in cognitive and motor skills, meanwhile, their more typically developing peers are better able to accept differences and become more aware of the needs of others.Students with disabilities have been diagnosed and classified as having a certain type(s) of disabilities which requires specialized services in order to maximize learning. …
title: Learning Mandarin Chinese as a Foreign Language: Evidence-Based Strategies for Teaching Students with Disabilities

title: Development of new PCR multiplex system by the simultaneous detection of 10 miniSTRs, SE33, Penta E, Penta D, and four Y-STRs

text: The Analysis and Prospect of Micro-Cognitive Foundations of Organizational Routines . The frontiers of organizational routines are the microfoundation of organizational routines,the analysis of which can lead to the better understanding of organizational routines. This paper firstly does some sortingout work on the research ideas of the microcognitive foundations of organizational routines,and then,according to the methodological individualism research paradigm,it makes some discussions about the microcognitive foundations of organizational routines from two perspectives of individual and organizations based on the mental models,on the basis of which a new concept interpretation is provided,and a distinction is made between the intrinsic essence and external characteristics of the concept. Finally,it gives a prospects for the future research.
title: The Analysis and Prospect of Micro-Cognitive Foundations of Organizational Routines
